purpose: Task 52: does the honest walk-forward conclusion (R2<0 on every model x horizon, no directional skill) hold when the universe expands from the canonical 8 CSV stocks to a deterministic 25-stock DB-selected pilot?

comparison_methodology.matched_pair: canonical8_cmp vs pilot25 SHARE identical evaluation methodology: SAMPLE_STEP=20 sessions, TRAIN_ROW_CAP=2500 (post-target-maturity-filter, deterministic seed=42), 50/15/35 chronological split, 5 models x 3 horizons, per-sample expanding-window retraining.
comparison_methodology.universe_difference: canonical8_cmp uses the fixed 8-stock CSV set (~2yr history, data to 2026-08); pilot25 selects 25 DB symbols by bar-count DESC + symbol ASC among >=250-bar non-XD symbols (~10yr history, 2016-2026). History depth and universe breadth differ BY DESIGN of the data sources; selection uses ONLY data coverage.
comparison_methodology.production_run_note: walk_forward_latest.json (canonical8, STEP=10, cap=5000) is the PRODUCTION artifact served by /api/backtest/walk-forward; it was re-run this task to restore the Task 51 production spec and is included for reference but is NOT part of the matched comparison pair.

key_findings: ALL model x horizon R2 values are NEGATIVE in every run (canonical8_cmp 15/15, pilot25 15/15, production 15/15) — no model beats the constant-mean R2 reference on any horizon.

Pilot25 avg R2 (-0.007..-0.041 by horizon) is closer to zero than canonical8_cmp (-0.028..-0.52): the 25-stock pooled cross-section + 10-year history gives models a richer training set, but still NO positive skill.
Directional accuracy stays ~coin-flip: pilot25 avg 0.472-0.517 by horizon vs canonical8_cmp 0.429-0.464. No horizon/model shows reliable directional skill.
At 10d/21d in pilot25, models UNDERPERFORM the zero-return baseline (avg model R2 -0.040/-0.026 vs zero-baseline -0.003/-0.027) — predicting 0 would have been as good or better.

Per-stock pilot results show a few small positive R2 values (max +0.082, GATM 21d, n=43) among 375 model-stock-horizon combos — consistent with noise given overlapping 21d windows and no uncertainty correction; NOT evidence of skill.
Conclusion: the honest negative-skill conclusion GENERALIZES from 8 to 25 stocks. Universe expansion does NOT change the assessment; the walk-forward harness now scales to the full DB universe.
honest_caveats: Sampling interval 20 sessions for the matched pair (10 for production) — adjacent 21d windows still overlap by 1 session; outcomes NOT independent.
TRAIN_ROW_CAP=2500 rows (matched pair) is a compute-practicality cap applied AFTER the target-maturity filter; eligible-row sets unchanged.

pilot25 selection covers the 25 LONGEST-HISTORY DB symbols (bar-count rule) — these 590 excluded symbols include 26 *XD duplicates and 564 below-capacity exclusions; the selection is deterministic and reproducible but is NOT the full ~908-symbol universe.
Trading metrics remain GROSS directional-return proxies (no commission/slippage/CGT); net P&L unavailable.
